name: plainsightil-root
description: Root workspace management scripts for PlainSightIL

scripts.client:start:dev: [ -f .env ] && export $(grep -v '^#' .env | xargs); cd client && flutter run -d chrome --web-port 8080 --dart-define=USE_EMULATOR=false --dart-define=ENVIRONMENT=dev --dart-define=FIREBASE_DEV_API_KEY=$FIREBASE_DEV_API_KEY
scripts.client:build:dev: [ -f .env ] && export $(grep -v '^#' .env | xargs); cd client && flutter build web --dart-define=USE_EMULATOR=false --dart-define=ENVIRONMENT=dev --dart-define=FIREBASE_DEV_API_KEY=$FIREBASE_DEV_API_KEY
scripts.client:deploy:dev: npm run client:build:dev && mkdir -p backend/build && rm -rf backend/build/web && cp -R client/build/web backend/build/web && cd backend && npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting --project plainsightil
